PokeI_SmallHouse.title: Small house
PokeI_SmallHouse.drawn: Three copies of the small house: an orange gable roof with its ridge front to back, a light band along the ridge and a light batten across its left slope, a gable of dark boards, brown board walls, the red door and a window in a white frame.

PokeI_ChimneyHouse.title: Chimney house
PokeI_ChimneyHouse.drawn: Two copies of the house with the chimney: a steep orange gable roof, a stone chimney on its right slope, a cream gable with two windows and dark boards under the ridge, brown board walls, a beam, the red door and a window in a cream panel.

PokeI_DayCare.title: Day care
PokeI_DayCare.drawn: The large building at the top by its fenced yard: a hall whose middle rises in a clerestory with a flat top and two light rails, hipped roofs of orange tiles over its sides and over a wing on its right, cream walls between dark timber posts, the double door of dark glass under a tiled canopy, windows.
